booking_kind_target.name: booking_kind_target
booking_kind_target.value:
("booking"."kind" = 'event' AND "booking"."event_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("booking"."kind" = 'rental' AND "booking"."rental_starts_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "booking"."rental_ends_at" > "booking"."rental_starts_at")

item_allocation_kind_target.name: item_allocation_kind_target
item_allocation_kind_target.value:
("item_allocation"."kind" = 'event' AND "item_allocation"."event_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("item_allocation"."kind" = 'rental' AND "item_allocation"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR "item_allocation"."kind" IN ('maintenance', 'block')
